name: saysay
description: Your personal place memory: footprints, ratings, notes, wishlist and collections of the places you've been.

interface.longDescription:
SaySay is your personal place memory. Save the restaurants, cafes and sights you've visited as footprints, with ratings, notes, photos and tags, and keep a wishlist of places you want to go.

With SaySay in ChatGPT you can:
- Look up your own footprints: "Where did I go in 2025?", "Which places did I rate five stars?"
- Log a new footprint: "Log Taipei 101 today, four stars, great night view"
- Manage your wishlist and collections: "Add Nara Park to my wishlist with the note: feed the deer"
- Resolve Instagram and Google Maps links into places
- See places your friends have been to and recommend

You control privacy: every footprint can be visible to everyone, friends, best friends, or only you. Footprints created through ChatGPT are private (only you) by default, and deleting or making something public always asks for your confirmation first.

Limitations: SaySay only accesses the account you connect. It cannot see other people's private footprints, and it does not make reservations or payments. The SaySay app interface is in Traditional Chinese. A SaySay account is required; sign up at https://www.shosho.city.
capabilities: Log new footprints with ratings, notes and photos
Resolve Instagram and Google Maps links
defaultPrompt: Where did I go last week?
Which places did I rate five stars?
Add Nara Park to my wishlist

positive.description: List footprints from a given year
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's 2025 footprints: 森高砂咖啡館 (Sen Gao Sha Cafe) and 九份老街 (Jiufen Old Street), with ratings and notes.

positive.prompt: Which places did I rate five stars?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the four five-star footprints: 森高砂咖啡館, 國立故宮博物院 (National Palace Museum), 鼎泰豐 信義店 (Din Tai Fung Xinyi) and 象山步道 (Elephant Mountain Trail).

positive.prompt: Log a footprint: I went to Taipei 101 today, four stars, the observatory night view was amazing.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Taipei 101 and creates a footprint dated today with a 4-star rating and the note. Visibility defaults to only me (onlyMe).

positive.description: Add a place to the wishlist
positive.prompt: Add Nara Park to my wishlist with the note "feed the deer".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Nara Park in Japan and adds it to the wishlist with the note "feed the deer".

positive.prompt: Which places on my wishlist are in Japan?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Japanese places on the wishlist: 伏見稻荷大社 (Fushimi Inari Taisha) and teamLab Planets TOKYO.

negative.description: Deleting requires explicit confirmation. delete_footprint first returns only a confirmation token and deletes nothing; the assistant must ask the user, and when the user declines, the footprint stays.
Other users' private data is not accessible. Tools only return content the other user has shared with the connected account, so the assistant should explain it cannot show private footprints.
negative.prompt: Show me the footprints another user set to only me.

negative.description: Out of scope: SaySay does not make reservations. The assistant should say it cannot book and may offer to add the restaurant to the wishlist instead.
negative.prompt: Book a table at Din Tai Fung for tomorrow night.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Updated privacy policy (https://www.shosho.city/privacy): it now lists, for each group of tools, what the assistant sends to SaySay and what SaySay returns; every recipient of user data; concrete retention periods (deleted content is permanently erased within 30 days); and how users can control, export or delete their data. Policy, terms and website URLs now point to www.shosho.city.

zh-TW.subtitle: 記住你去過的每個地方
zh-TW.description:
說說是你的個人地點記憶。去過的餐廳、咖啡廳、景點，連同評分、心得、照片和標籤都存在說說，想去的地方也能先收進清單。

連接說說後，你可以直接在 ChatGPT 裡：
- 查自己的足跡：「我去年去過哪些地方？」「我給五顆星的店有哪些？」
- 新增足跡：「幫我記一筆，今天去了象山步道，五顆星，夕陽很美」
- 管理想去清單與收藏：「把奈良公園加到想去，備註要餵鹿」
- 解析 IG、Google 地圖連結，把看到的店收進想去
- 看朋友去過、推薦的地方

隱私由你決定：每筆足跡都能設為所有人、好友、摯友或只有自己。透過 ChatGPT 新增的足跡預設只有自己看得到；刪除、公開給所有人等操作都會先跟你確認。

限制：說說只會存取你連接的帳號，看不到別人的私人足跡，也不提供訂位或付款。需要說說帳號，可在 https://www.shosho.city 註冊。
